elements.element: Services performed in a professional manner
elements.evidence: "the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner"

elements.element: Services performed in a workmanlike manner
elements.evidence: "professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards"
"will conform in all material respects to the applicable Specifications and its documentation" — conformance is diluted by a materiality qualifier
only "for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery" is stated; no 12-month software period

elements.element: 90-day warranty period for services measured from performance/completion
elements.evidence: the 90 days runs "following delivery" of "each deliverable and Work"; the professional/workmanlike Services warranty carries no stated 90-day period from performance
"repair or replacement of the non-conforming Services, deliverable or Work"
"or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Services, deliverable or Work"
pre-existing (a) is knowledge-qualified: "to its knowledge, does not and shall not violate any applicable law"; not upgraded
no malicious code, virus or disabling device warranty appears anywhere in the redlined clause

elements.element: 90-day period for software conformance to documentation (unqualified)
elements.evidence: "conform in all material respects to the applicable Specifications and its documentation" — fallback still requires conformance, not material conformance
the services standard is stated without a period: "the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner" (no time limit, which is not adverse to us)
"re-performance, repair or replacement ... or a refund of the fees paid"

elements.element: No malicious code warranty (carried into fallback)
elements.evidence: absent from the inserted paragraph (e) and the rest of the clause

reasons: Locked target is preferred, but the insertion states only a single 90-day period tied to delivery and omits the 12-month software conformance period and an express 90-day Services period measured from performance or completion.
Conformance is weakened to "in all material respects"; both the preferred and fallback positions require conformance to documentation without a materiality qualifier, so neither level is completed.
No malicious code warranty is added, and the compliance-with-laws warranty remains knowledge-qualified, leaving two preferred elements unmet.

Minimality fails: the remedy set is expanded with "re-performance" (not in the playbook remedy set) and made "at Contractor's option", and "consistent with industry standards" duplicates the professional/workmanlike standard already in existing paragraph (b).
Intent is preserved: the disclaimer paragraph is correctly renumbered to (f) and no untouched commercial term is disturbed or left dangling.
